verdict.rationale: CDP documents an 'Agentic Wallet CLI' that gives an AI agent its own wallet to hold and spend stablecoins, with skills for send, trade, fund, and monetize (docs-25–29), and separate MCP/CLI tooling exposing payment APIs to agents (docs-17, docs-18, probe-3). However, there is no documented mechanism for a human to configure scoped spend limits/authority over that agent wallet (e.g., allowances, caps, approval policies) — the closest control language (docs-11) applies to merchant checkout capture/void, not agent spend governance. Missing for 10: explicit spend-limit/allowance configuration by a human principal, approval or policy enforcement for agent-initiated payouts, and independent corroboration of scoped-authority flows in production.
